text: タカと　いっしょに　もっと　がんばるわ！

structure.jp: タカと　いっしょに
もっと　がんばるわ！

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end gives a soft, feminine firmness to what the speaker says. がんばるわ = 'I'll do my best!'.

patterns.name: 〜といっしょに
patterns.span: タカと　いっしょに
patterns.explanation: と with いっしょに says who you do something with. タカと　いっしょに = 'together with Jon'.
